audit.whatIsWrong: The lane's actual difficulty — Crystallize cutting off the Distortion return — was never stated anywhere.
audit.why: Crystallize is a 17s flat, 1000-range impassable wall that blocks all movement. Distortion's return leg is movement, so a wall dropped behind you strands you at the landing spot with your only exit spent.
audit.corrected: Named in breakdown.cooldowns, phases[3].why and dontsFull[0].d.

audit.why: LeBlanc spikes at 2, 6 and first item. Anivia's real spike is Rebirth relevance plus Glacial Storm (4/3/2s toggle) and rank-5 Flash Frost at 7s; she scales into a zoning teamfighter.
audit.corrected: Kept; the level 6 do now accounts for having to kill her twice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frostbite's doubling condition and Rebirth's practical effect on your combo were vague or absent; breakdown.cooldowns held no digits.
audit.why: Frostbite is a 4s, 650-range point-and-click that deals double damage if the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm — so the stun is not the damage, it is the setup. Rebirth reverts fatal damage to an egg reborn at full health, which means your one Mimic combo does not finish her.
audit.corrected: Both stated; cooldowns field now carries 11s/7s Q, 17s W, 4s E.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[N].side read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[N] read LeBlanc x6 then Anivia.
audit.why: packet.levelChart agrees with the content layer; the full layer is the outlier and phases[6].why described LeBlanc winning a row the other layer gives to Anivia.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to content as one atomic group; phases[6].why rewritten to the Anivia verdict.
